leadText: Makoto Mizobuchi (Japanese: Mizobuchi Makoto) is the creator of several Pokémon manga series. Aside from Pokémon, Mizobuchi is also known for The Gate Keeper of Hell's History, Zoids Battle Card Warriors - Commander Teru, Hidemaru the Soccer Boy and Iron Soul!! Zoids Hand-to-Hand Fighting. Mizobuchi has also illustrated for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, illustrating card.
plainText:
Makoto Mizobuchi (Japanese: Mizobuchi Makoto) is the creator of several Pokémon manga series. Aside from Pokémon, Mizobuchi is also known for The Gate Keeper of Hell's History, Zoids Battle Card Warriors - Commander Teru, Hidemaru the Soccer Boy and Iron Soul!! Zoids Hand-to-Hand Fighting. Mizobuchi has also illustrated for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, illustrating card.
